decision.if: keyless: one change makes unrelated pins due, or a contradiction in an existing note is never signalled
decision.then: GBRA-108 ships the scheduling fix it accepted, and we rerun the keyless arm on that release

decision.if: keyless: neither scheduling failure appears on the counted seeds
decision.then: we withdraw the fix request and correct the handoff

decision.if: keyless: the false-flag rate on unrelated edits to cited pages has a 95% lower bound above 10%
decision.then: the paragraph-level evidence design note goes to GBRA-108 as a plan to build; otherwise it closes

decision.if: paid: particle-1 is non-inferior to claude-opus-5-5 within 10 points on refreshed-answer correctness
decision.then: we ask GBRA-108 to document particle-1 as the low-cost models.standing_questions choice

decision.if: paid: particle-1 is inferior or the result is inconclusive
decision.then: we document that refreshes stay on the deep tier, or recommend nothing at this sample size

decision.if: paid: more than 5% of a model's pilot pin and refresh calls are cut off at gbrain's 2,000-token output cap
decision.then: we report the cap to GBRA-108 as a gbrain finding, run the raised-cap arm (8,000 tokens) on the counted seeds, and the particle-1 recommendation names the cap at which it holds

decision.if: paid: Opus correctness after a contradiction is at least 15 points below its correctness after a direct edit
decision.then: design note to GBRA-108: recompute in full when new in-scope evidence arrives
